title: ISSRE 2026 Awards
summary: The ISSRE 2026 awards have been announced in Limassol, Cyprus! Congratulations to all winners of the Test of Time Award & Runner-Up, Distinguished Papers across Research, RENE, and Industry tracks, Best Artifact Award, and Distinguished Reviewers.
content:
The IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE) is delighted to celebrate the distinguished contributions and research recognized at ISSRE 2026 in Limassol, Cyprus.

🏆 Test of Time Award:
• Experience Report: System Log Analysis for Anomaly Detection
  Authors: Shilin He, Jieming Zhu, Pinjia He, and Michael R. Lyu

🥈 Test of Time Runner-Up:
• Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Localization in Virtual Network Functions
  Authors: Carla Sauvanaud, Kahina Lazri, Mohamed Kaâniche, and Karama Kanoun

📄 Research Track Distinguished Papers:
• Calibration Without Comprehension: Diagnosing the Limits of Fine-Tuning LLMs for Vulnerability Detection in Systems Software
  Authors: Arastoo Zibaeirad and Marco Vieira
• ProvScope: A tool to assist cybersecurity analysts in identifying information flows in complex systems
  Authors: Loic Robert, Vincent Nicomette, Eric Lacombe, Marie-José Huguet and Emmanuel Hebrard
• Resilient Page Table Management under ECC-uncorrectable Memory Errors
  Authors: Kazuki Takeda and Hiroshi Yamada
• RotDroid: Cross-Orientation State Equivalence Testing for Detecting GUI Rotation Bugs in Android Apps
  Authors: Mengdi Qin and Bo Jiang
• When Agents Fail: A Comprehensive Study of Bugs in LLM Agents with Automated Labeling
  Authors: Niful Islam, Ragib Shahriar Ayon, Deepak George Thomas, Shibbir Ahmed and Mohammad Wardat

📄 RENE Track Distinguished Paper:
• From Benchmark Accuracy to Diagnostic Boundaries: A Time-Aware Replication of DEST
  Authors: Hang Cui, Cenjie Hu, Changhua Pei, Juncheng Hu, Haotian Si, Zihan Liu, Ke Xiang, Yuxuan Li, Quan Zhou, Xiaohui Nie, Zexin Wang, Jingjing Li, Dan Pei and Gaogang Xie

💼 Industry Track Distinguished Papers:
• Bridging the Mitigation Gap: A Taxonomy-Driven Empirical Study of Incident Recovery in Production LLM Serving
  Authors: Bhala Ranganathan and Minghua Ma
• Making Deployments Safe at Meta: Health Checks for Continuous Change-Safety
  Authors: Prakash Kl, Anton Korenkov, Uttam Thakore and Christopher Hegre
• The Prover Is the Judge: Verified Security Software from AI Coding Agents in Ada/SPARK
  Authors: Tobias Philipp

⚙️ Best Artifact Award:
• SIEVE: Hybrid Hardware/Software Detection of Multi-Bit Errors in Random-Access Memory
  Authors: Robin Thunig, Christoph Borchert, Urs Kober, and Horst Schirmeier

title: ISSRE 2028 and 2029 Host Locations
summary: The ISSRE Steering Committee has officially announced the host locations for the upcoming editions of the symposium: Coimbra, Portugal (ISSRE 2028) and Sydney, Australia (ISSRE 2029).
content:
The IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE) Steering Committee is pleased to announce the selection of host locations for the 39th and 40th editions of the symposium:

• ISSRE 2028: Coimbra, Portugal. The symposium returns to this historic university city, a renowned hub of software engineering and dependability research in Europe.
• ISSRE 2029: Sydney, Australia. The 40th anniversary edition of ISSRE will be held in the southern hemisphere, bringing the software reliability community to Australia.

We congratulate both local organizing committees and look forward to two exceptional editions!

title: ISSRE 2026 Keynotes
summary: We are proud to announce the distinguished Keynote Speakers for ISSRE 2026 in Cyprus: Prof. Don Syme (GitHub Next), Prof. Paolo Tonella (USI), and Prof. Laurie Williams (NCSU).
content:
We are excited to share the distinguished Keynote Speakers for the upcoming IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2026) in Paphos, Cyprus:

Prof. Don Syme (GitHub Next & King's College London)
  • Title: The Agentic Repository Automation Revolution
  • Overview: Exploring Continuous AI (CAI) in repository automation, AI-assisted code improvement, performance engineering, and automated formal verification.

Prof. Paolo Tonella (Università della Svizzera italiana - USI)
  • Title: AI Testing: What have we learned? Where are we heading?
  • Overview: Analyzing the exponential growth of deep learning model testing, test adequacy assessment, model-level vs. system-level failures, and quality evaluation of LLM-generated code.

Prof. Laurie Williams (North Carolina State University - NCSU)
  • Title: Dependable Software, Untrusted Parts: Security Research for the Software Supply Chain
  • Overview: Examining software supply chain security, lessons from the NSF S3C2 center, software provenance, vulnerability intelligence, developer environment security, and trustworthy software production systems in the era of AI-assisted development.

Join us in Cyprus this October to attend these keynotes and meet the speakers!

title: ISSRE 2027 Co-Chairs
summary: The PC Co-Chairs (Weiyi Shang, Naghmeh Ivaki) and Industry Co-Chairs (Nuno Silva, Guangtai Liang, Yajin Zhou) for ISSRE 2027 in Macau have been officially appointed.
content:
Following the selection of the General Co-Chairs for ISSRE 2027, the Steering Committee has finalized the appointments for the Program Committee (PC) Co-Chairs and Industry Co-Chairs for the upcoming symposium.

Program Committee (PC) Co-Chairs:
  • Weiyi Shang (University of Waterloo, Canada)
  • Naghmeh Ivaki (University of Coimbra, Portugal)

Industry Co-Chairs:
  • Nuno Silva (Critical Software, Portugal)
  • Guangtai Liang (Huawei Cloud Computing Technologies, China)
  • Yajin Zhou (Zhejiang University, China)

These leading researchers and practitioners will guide the technical tracks and industrial sessions to ensure a high-quality, impactful program for the 38th edition of the symposium.

title: ISSRE 2027 to be Hosted in Macau
summary: We are thrilled to officially announce Macau as the host city for the 38th edition of the symposium in 2027, with General Co-Chairs Tao Zhang and Barbara Gallina.
content:
The ISSRE Steering Committee is pleased to share that Macau has been selected to host the IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE) in 2027. We are also delighted to announce the General Co-Chairs for this edition: Tao Zhang (Macau University of Science and Technology, Macau) and Barbara Gallina (Mälardalen University, Sweden).

Macau offers a rich cultural heritage, outstanding conference facilities, and is a major hub connecting researchers across Asia and globally. The local organizing committee has already begun preliminary planning under their leadership. Official dates, venue details, and the call for papers will be announced on the upcoming 2027 website later this year.
